newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Mammography launches MRI test.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Mammography launches MRI test.

text.p: Advanced Mammography Systems Inc said Monday that it is launching a multi-center clinical study to assess the clinical efficacy of its Aurora system.
According to the company, Aurora is the only dedicated breast magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) system that is cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The multi-center study is intended to establish the diagnostic utility of MRI using the Aurora system and to address its application as a screening modality for breast cancer.
